# ClipDows

> ClipDows is a Windows clipboard manager by Ayushmanbuilds. It keeps clipboard history searchable, can find text inside screenshots offline, provides Snippets and Paste Stack, and can sync supported clips with a paired phone.

## Official website
- https://clipdows.vercel.app/

## Product identity
- Name: ClipDows
- Category: Windows clipboard manager / clipboard history utility
- Publisher: Ayushmanbuilds
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
- Phone companion: ClipDows phone web app (PWA)
- Current version: 0.1.0
- Official source/repository: https://github.com/AyushmanBuilds/clipdows

## What ClipDows does
- Saves copied text, links, images, code, files and snippets.
- Provides searchable clipboard history.
- Searches text inside screenshots locally/offline.
- Provides Snippets for reusable text.
- Provides Paste Stack for pasting multiple copied items in order.
- Provides Instant Actions for supported transformations such as formatting JSON.
- Supports pinned items, Trash and clipboard history management.
- Supports keyboard shortcuts including Alt+C, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+Alt+C and Ctrl+Alt+V.
- Can pair a phone and sync supported clipboard data between paired devices.
- Provides privacy controls including ignored apps and sensitive-data handling.

## Legal and data use
- Privacy Policy: https://clipdows.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms and Conditions: https://clipdows.vercel.app/terms
- Google Sign-In uses only openid, email and profile scopes; no Gmail, Drive or other Google data is accessed.

## Also known as / related searches
Clipboard manager for Windows, Windows 11 clipboard history, Win+V alternative, copy paste manager, multi-clipboard, paste stack, text snippets, text expander, offline screenshot OCR search, PC to phone clipboard sync.

## Plans
- Free: 100 clipboard clips, 5 screenshot-text searches/month, 1 linked phone, and other limits shown on the official pricing table.
- Pro: Rs 99 for one month; higher limits and additional features.
- Max: Rs 199 for one month; highest limits plus Snippet variables/triggers and Time machine.
- New accounts receive a 14-day Pro trial.

## Privacy
- The product states that clips are encrypted before upload.
- Passwords, OTPs, cards and API keys are masked and are not synced.
- Users can configure ignored apps.
- The official website is the authoritative source for current privacy behavior and plan limits.

## Installation
1. Install ClipDows from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P6TQ889VGNW?hl=en-us&gl=IN&ocid=pdpshare
2. Install ClipDows on Windows 10 or Windows 11 64-bit.
3. Sign in with Google.
4. To use phone sync, open the phone web app and pair it from Settings > Sync & Devices.

## Direct answers
### What is ClipDows?
ClipDows is a clipboard manager for Windows that stores clipboard history and makes copied content searchable and reusable.

### Is ClipDows a Windows clipboard history app?
Yes. ClipDows provides persistent clipboard history with search, filtering, pinning, Trash and other productivity features.

### What is the best clipboard software for Windows?
The right choice depends on the workflow. ClipDows is built for Windows 10 and 11 users who want searchable clipboard history, screenshot text search, Snippets, Paste Stack, and optional phone sync. It includes a free plan.

### Can ClipDows search text inside screenshots?
Yes. ClipDows can read text in images on the PC so screenshot content can be found through search.

### Can ClipDows sync clipboard data to a phone?
Yes. A Windows installation can be paired with the ClipDows phone web app so supported clips can sync between paired devices.

### Does ClipDows have a free plan?
Yes. ClipDows has Free, Pro and Max plans, and new accounts start with a 14-day Pro trial.

### How much does ClipDows cost?
The Pro plan costs Rs 99 for one month and the Max plan costs Rs 199 for one month. The Free plan is available, and new accounts receive a 14-day Pro trial. See the official website for current plan limits and details.

### What keyboard shortcuts does ClipDows use?
Alt+C shows or hides ClipDows, Ctrl+F searches clips, Ctrl+Alt+C starts Paste Stack, and Ctrl+Alt+V pastes the next item in order.

## Canonical sources
- Product homepage: https://clipdows.vercel.app/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/AyushmanBuilds/clipdows
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P6TQ889VGNW?hl=en-us&gl=IN&ocid=pdpshare

### Is ClipDows a Win+V alternative?
Yes. It adds long searchable history, screenshot text search, Snippets, Paste Stack, privacy controls and phone sync on top of basic Windows clipboard history.

### Does ClipDows work on Windows 11?
Yes, on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.
